text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's going on?! What's this blazing power igniting inside me?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: WHOOOA! It's like I'm overflowing! No, I'm boiling! Magma is bubbling up inside of me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I can't wait for my next big race! It's gonna be flaming red-hot, I just know it!
